title: 30 years of mall dreams, mapped
content: Started having semi-lucid, recurring mall dreams when I was a kid — it’s something I’ve talked about with friends and family throughout my life. As life has changed, so has the mall and surrounding scenes. I felt compelled to try to map it out the other day — here was my first attempt. It’s def not to scale and for sure not all-encompassing of this massive knot of neurons that exist somewhere in my brain that make this dream possible so often. (That’s not to say I’m close-minded to woo. Maybe we all share a sub-conscience dreamspace. Who knows!) So many of the scenes and ideas posted here resonate with my own imagery — thought it would be interesting to compare notes! Almost everything on this map has occurred at least several dozen times — it ebbs and flows, but these tend to come pretty frequently. Even more so now that I have a newborn — I think REM rebound and disrupted sleep states have something to do with this! Happy to geek out on theories.
